tools.name: execute
tools.description: Typecheck and run one async TypeScript function body in a fresh QuickJS runtime. Completed operations may already have effects and are never replayed.

code.description: The body of one async TypeScript function with top-level await and return. It is checked against the caller-visible declaration before QuickJS starts. At most 64 KiB after UTF-8 encoding; a shape or source-size failure is -32602.

timeout_ms.description: Whole-call wall clock in milliseconds: at least 1,000, never above the compiled 300,000 ceiling, and never above the owner's configured maximum. A request over the configured maximum is refused -32602; it is never clamped.

outputSchema.description: The bounded execute result, discriminated by `kind`. Request failures are -32602 and never appear here; an over-max integer timeout returns data.field and data.max.

oneOf.description: The program returned a valid bounded JSON value.

value.description: The program return value: acyclic JSON (null, booleans, strings, finite numbers, arrays, plain string-keyed objects) under the result byte cap.

stdout.description: Captured user stdout, live-return only and byte-capped; never logged or persisted.

stderr.description: Captured user stderr, live-return only and byte-capped; never logged or persisted.

stdoutTruncated.description: True when stdout hit its byte cap and was cut.

stderrTruncated.description: True when stderr hit its byte cap and was cut.

operations.description: Inner operations that completed during the run.

oneOf.description: TypeScript syntax or semantic checking failed before evaluation.

message.description: Bounded compiler message with no submitted source excerpt.

oneOf.description: The program failed during compilation or evaluation; the failure is never replayed.

cause.description: Sanitized bounded failure class; never source, credentials, or raw runtime text.

message.description: Bounded guest exception message; empty only when the thrown value has none.

stack.description: Bounded guest stack with generated filename and locations but no source excerpt.

stdout.description: Captured user stdout, live-return only and byte-capped; never logged or persisted.

stderr.description: Captured user stderr, live-return only and byte-capped; never logged or persisted.

stdoutTruncated.description: True when stdout hit its byte cap and was cut.

stderrTruncated.description: True when stderr hit its byte cap and was cut.

transient.description: Whether a retry could plausibly succeed.

mayHaveRun.description: Whether an inner operation could have dispatched before the failure.

oneOf.description: A named limit stopped the execution.

limit.description: The violated limit's name (§23.11's caps, e.g. `memory`, `stack`, `cpu`, `wall_clock`, `inner_operations`).

observed.description: The observed quantity in that limit's own unit — bytes, count, or milliseconds; never source text or a credential.

transient.description: Whether a retry could plausibly succeed; deterministic guest limits are not transient.

mayHaveRun.description: Whether an inner operation could have dispatched before the limit stopped the run.

tools.name: search_types
tools.description: Search this credential's hub TypeScript declarations and canonical catalog. Case-insensitive, non-fuzzy, ranked; starts no execution runtime.

query.description: Case-insensitive, non-fuzzy search text: non-empty after trimming and at most 256 UTF-8 bytes before trimming. The `maxLength` keyword counts UTF-16 code units; the byte cap is enforced on the bytes.

surface.description: Which declaration surface to search; defaults to `program`.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return; defaults to 10.

matches.description: Ranked matches: exact TypeScript path/canonical identity, then prefix, then substring, then description substring; ties by kind, canonical service, then canonical subject.

path.description: TypeScript path the entry is reachable through.

service.description: Canonical service name; never a TypeScript alias.

subject.description: Canonical tool name, raw resource URI, or raw resource-template URI; never an alias.

signature.description: Rendered TypeScript signature for the entry.

uri.description: Direct declaration resource URI for this match.

diagnostics.description: Bounded mapping/catalog diagnostics attached to this match.

incomplete.description: True when a limit cut the ranked list to its canonical prefix; the missing tail is never guessed at.

resources.name: client.d.ts
resources.description: The external hub facade declarations: mcp.hub.execute and mcp.hub.searchTypes. A declaration surface only; never loaded into the program checker.

resources.name: program.d.ts
resources.description: The program global mcp declarations: authorized canonical service tools, structured resource reads, and the local searchTypes helper. Deliberately no mcp.hub.execute.

resourceTemplates.name: Service declarations
resourceTemplates.description: TypeScript declarations for one canonical service. `{service}` is exactly one `encodeURIComponent`-encoded segment.

resourceTemplates.name: Tool declarations
resourceTemplates.description: TypeScript declarations for one canonical tool within one canonical service. `{service}` and `{tool}` are each exactly one `encodeURIComponent`-encoded segment.

resourceTemplates.name: Resource declarations
resourceTemplates.description: TypeScript declarations for one raw resource URI within one canonical service. `{uri}` is exactly one `encodeURIComponent`-encoded segment and never becomes path structure.

resourceTemplates.name: Resource-template declarations
resourceTemplates.description: TypeScript declarations for one raw resource-template URI within one canonical service. `{uriTemplate}` is exactly one `encodeURIComponent`-encoded segment and never becomes path structure.
